topic: Olds & Milner (1954) Bent Septal Electrode & Berridge & Kringelbach (2015) Dopamine Wanting vs Liking Dissociation (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Clinical and modern neurochemical mapping by a senior researcher proves Olds's famous self-stimulation highway drives relentless dopamine 'wanting' (incentive salience) completely separate from tiny hedonic 'liking' hotspots.
